command:
set -eu
cd /workspace/omega_runtime
printf 'ENV_NONSECRET_PATHS\n'
for p in /workspace/omega_runtime/current/omega/grid_runtime_v3.py /workspace/omega_runtime/current/omega/unified_store.py /workspace/omega_runtime/current/omega/master_bridge_carrier.py /workspace/omega_runtime/current/schema/omega.sql; do stat -c '%n %s bytes' "$p" 2>/dev/null || :; done
printf 'STATE TOP\n'; ls -la /workspace/omega_runtime/state | head -65
printf 'CURRENT FILES\n'; find /workspace/omega_runtime/current -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*context*' -o -iname '*voice*' | head -30
printf 'DB ENV PATH DEFINITIONS\n'; grep -nE 'OMEGA_(DB|RUNTIME_ROOT|GRID|STATE)|default=|UnifiedStore|add_argument' /workspace/omega_runtime/current/omega/grid_runtime_v3.py | tail -35
printf 'CURRENT_SUPERVISOR config\n'; sed -n '15,95p' /workspace/omega_runtime/current/omega/supervisor.py
printf 'MASTER MAILBOX COUNTS\n'; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/{submitted,responses}; do printf '%s: ' "$p"; find "$p" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; done
printf 'PROCESSES omega count\n'; pgrep -af 'omega.(grid_runtime|supervisor|master_bridge|relay)' | head -30 || :
